name: Alexander Martinez
source:
Alexander is the second son of entrepreneurs Javier Martinez and Rosa Maria Martinez. Alexander's parents moved to Las Vegas in 1989 and opened La Casita, an authentic Mexican restaurant based on traditional recipes. Alexander has one sibling, Roman, who became incredibly successful and wealthy by creating the popular beer brand Noche Siesta.

Alexander spends every day trying to help his parents at La Casita. His parents, overworked and past retirement age, do not appreciate him enough. Due to Alexander constantly living in his brother Roman's shadow, and having few future prospects for his own success, his melancholic and envious nature made him a suitable candidate for Lucifer's Deadly Sin of Envy.

He may be more difficult to seduce, the longer you wait...
